facts.profile-throne: The queen sits on the throne in profile, looking to the right.
facts.upright-sword: In her right hand she holds a sword straight upright.
facts.extended-hand: Her left hand is raised forward with the palm held out, and a cord ornament hangs at the wrist.
facts.butterfly-crown: She wears a crown with butterfly ornaments, and a winged baby's face and butterflies are carved on the throne.
facts.cloud-cape: She wears a cloak with a cloud pattern.
facts.clouds-bird: Clouds spread below, and a bird flies high in the sky.

glosses.extended-hand: A hand held out even after judging; room for conversation.
glosses.clouds-bird: A clarity that flies high above what is cloudy.

reversedGloss.excess: Coolness and criticism go too far and feel cold.
reversedGloss.internalized: Sadness is not shown and hardens inside.

misdescriptions.wrong: She lays the sword across her knees.
